data.name: Khyber
data.gender_notes: Khyber is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A place where armies pass through during war, symbolizing the trials and struggles one faces in life. In Islamic history, Khyber is mentioned as the location of a major battle where Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) led his army against the Jewish tribe Banu Qurayza. The name Khyber carries the meaning “Passage, mountain pass” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khyber usually hope their child will grow to embody passage, mountain pass and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Khyber holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is believed to represent the journey of the soul through the mountains of life, overcoming obstacles and challenges on the path to enlightenment.
data.etymology: Khyber belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Passage, mountain pass.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khyber total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
